name: v2.3.1
body:
## What's Changed
* feat(ai): add an Embeddings mode to the AI Quick Start by @ssrajadh in https://github.com/InsForge/InsForge/pull/1889
* Observability: always-on memory advisory + Supabase-style disk breakdown card by @tonychang04 in https://github.com/InsForge/InsForge/pull/1900
* docs(readme): self-host with setup.sh instead of .env.example placeholders by @Fermionic-Lyu in https://github.com/InsForge/InsForge/pull/1901
* feat(compute): self-hosted Docker driver for custom containers by @Fermionic-Lyu in https://github.com/InsForge/InsForge/pull/1892
* Disk breakdown: semantic colors (Database green / WAL amber / System gray) by @tonychang04 in https://github.com/InsForge/InsForge/pull/1904
* Disk breakdown: Database band on the house emerald-300 accent by @tonychang04 in https://github.com/InsForge/InsForge/pull/1905
* docs(deploy): run setup.sh per directory for multiple instances by @Fermionic-Lyu in https://github.com/InsForge/InsForge/pull/1902
* Disk card: data-scoped frame (ceiling = your space, System becomes a footnote) by @tonychang04 in https://github.com/InsForge/InsForge/pull/1907
* Observability: Figma disk breakdown chart, bar-mode CPU/Memory, 70%+ memory advisory by @tonychang04 in https://github.com/InsForge/InsForge/pull/1919
* docs(deploy): add Hetzner Cloud VPS self-host guide by @Harsh-Daga in https://github.com/InsForge/InsForge/pull/1910
* 2026-08-09 fix mintlify docs by @insforge-docs-bot[bot] in https://github.com/InsForge/InsForge/pull/1914
* feat(deploy): add deploy/backup.sh for self-host backups by @Harsh-Daga in https://github.com/InsForge/InsForge/pull/1913
* fix(dashboard): stop the capacity fallback stacking its oldest bars by @ayaangazali in https://github.com/InsForge/InsForge/pull/1917
* docs(openapi): document 404 for function invoke methods by @Gautam-aman in https://github.com/InsForge/InsForge/pull/1922
* ci: validate changed OpenAPI specs in lint-and-format by @ayaangazali in https://github.com/InsForge/InsForge/pull/1847
* feat(ai): show why the Model Gateway is unavailable, and hide it for partner orgs by @Fermionic-Lyu in https://github.com/InsForge/InsForge/pull/1933
* feat(compute): Docker compute driver for self-hosted InsForge by @Fermionic-Lyu in https://github.com/InsForge/InsForge/pull/1930
* Bump version to 2.3.1 by @agent-zhang-beihai[bot] in https://github.com/InsForge/InsForge/pull/1934

## New Contributors
* @ssrajadh made their first contribution in https://github.com/InsForge/InsForge/pull/1889
* @Harsh-Daga made their first contribution in https://github.com/InsForge/InsForge/pull/1910

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/InsForge/InsForge/compare/v2.3.0...v2.3.1
